segments.text: The outskirts of the Ebelstein Labyrinth.
Derek, along with his friends and Elente.
"Wait, you're asking me to go into a labyrinth? Me?" "It's the lowest ranked one. Shouldn't be too difficult.
You need to develop real combat instincts."
Elente is scared, but Derek reminds her, "The spar is only days away.
When time is this short, this is the best method there is."
Elente is disgusted by the surroundings.
Derek tells her to stay alert.
along with something bigger, an ogre.
The big guy takes the ogre. Derek and the other girl handle the goblins.
Multiple pairs of eyes glow in the dark.
Elente is still frozen in horror.
Derek takes the front line, the girl covering from behind.
The big guy faces the ogre
"These monsters are really trying to kill me. I could actually die."
Derek shouts, calling out to her.
One monster is closing in on her position. "Stay focused."
A goblin charges straight at her.
Her past self, the one who only knew envy, who only tore others down,
someone who wants to kill that old self
The goblin is struck down by an ice spear.
The big guy nods in approval.
Elente finally takes a step forward.
No, not just a step, her first step. Like and follow for part 11.
